name: F_r = injected external score (B0+ channel probe)
note: NOT the round-one shared rule. This declaration is in force only for `run --inject-scores`: an externally supplied scalar replaces the scalar(E*) search signal so that the study can observe whether a score the substrate did not derive from E* can change the selection (B0+ channel existence). The score event still carries E*'s true multi-field Outcome in `outcome`; only `search_signal` and the selection input come from the injection. Events under this F_r must never be pooled with F_r = scalar(E*) events.
